status: FROZEN before any confirmatory (seeds 1,000,000-1,000,199) match was played
evidence_used_to_write_this_spec: development set only (seeds 1,100,000-1,100,029, n=30/policy) for measurement validity, noise and proxy recall; NOT for choosing a metric because Q looked good on it. Seeds 900000-900199 were already used for the earlier goal-difference test and are not used here.

primary.contrast: q_learning minus native_unmodified, paired by seed, two-sided, alpha=0.05
primary.rationale: proximal outcome of a defensive-depth coach (opponent possession time in our defensive third); continuous, CV 0.33 on dev; dev manipulation check shows the tactic moves it (compact 348 vs stretched 410 steps). Chosen on mechanism and measurement quality, not on Q's dev result.

secondary_rule: Q vs native, sign-flip p-values Holm-adjusted across these 8; all other metrics are exploratory/descriptive whatever they show.
strongest_fixed_rule: lowest dev mean of the primary metric among {native, fixed_compact, fixed_stretched}: compact 348 < native 401 < stretched 410. Also reported: the fixed policy best on the TEST mean per metric (favours the baseline).
metric_definitions: stats_metrics.py (parameters P frozen at the values in that file at freeze time); min_spell=2; shot proxy thresholds as in P. Sensitivity to min_spell 1/3 and shot thresholds is reported, not used for selection.
state_dependence_test: Q vs q_learning_shuffled_obs (same policy fed states drawn at random from its own visits) on every metric; plus NMI(action; zone x ownership x score x phase) above a permutation null.

decision_rules.improves_a_statistic: paired 95% CI vs native excludes 0 in the better direction AND (primary: p<0.05; secondary: Holm-adjusted p<0.05)
decision_rules.reflects_learned_state_dependent_adaptat: improves vs native AND CI vs q_learning_shuffled_obs excludes 0 in the better direction AND CI vs strongest fixed baseline excludes 0 in the better direction
decision_rules.otherwise: reported as not demonstrated; CIs give the smallest effects that cannot be excluded

uncertainty: 10,000-resample bootstrap over seeds (paired and unpaired), sign-flip permutation p; pooled time-to-regain uses a cluster bootstrap over matches
